verdicts.reason: A: the headline, body and CTA sit jammed against the left edge with almost no margin. The 'Now in 4-packs' fine print is bigger than the body copy and sits above the CTA, so the hierarchy is inverted. The can has also slid off its backing circle, leaving dead space in the middle. B: the CTA button and the 4-packs line are shrunk to microscopic, illegible text. That buries the call to action. The text block also floats off-centre with an empty left third, and the can is again detached from its circle.
